episodes.title: To the Waters and the Wild
episodes.summary: In hopes of mastering her magic, Bloom begins her studies at Alfea — and crosses paths with her curious classmates. Meanwhile, a secret comes to light.

episodes.title: No Strangers Here
episodes.summary: A new day dawns as the students explore their powers… and feelings. Bloom and Stella team up for a mission. The Burned One's reign of terror evolves.

episodes.title: Heavy Mortal Hopes
episodes.summary: Past meets present as Bloom explores a pivotal memory. Meanwhile, Aisha struggles with her studies, Silva shares a secret and a school party takes shape.

episodes.title: Some Wrecked Angel
episodes.summary: Bloom continues her search for answers with Sky. Beatrix works to conceal her crime. A special guest visits Alfea — and leaves Stella feeling conflicted.

episodes.title: Wither Into the Truth
episodes.summary: In order to reconnect with Beatrix, Bloom seeks the help of a fellow student. Sky opens up about his past. Ms. Dowling shares more of her story.

episodes.title: A Fanatic Heart
episodes.summary: As the Alfeans fight for survival, the truth about Bloom's destiny is revealed. Can she help defeat the Burned Ones — or will evil outperform magic?

episodes.title: Low-Flying Panic Attack
episodes.summary: Bloom and her friends, chafing under Rosalind's new regime at Alfea, make a risky plan to free Silva. Aisha meets someone. Sky is still processing.

episodes.title: Taken By The Wind
episodes.summary: A new student's arrival surprises Terra, who's investigating what happened to Devin. Bloom learns more about Sky's childhood when they leave campus.

episodes.title: Your Newfound Popularity
episodes.summary: The school prepares for the alumni banquet, where Stella is determined to expose Rosalind's true nature. Sam struggles to cope, and Aisha takes a risk.

episodes.title: An Hour Before the Devil Fell
episodes.summary: A pub night in town is interrupted by alarming news about Beatrix, sending the students into a dangerous confrontation with a mysterious Blood Witch.

episodes.title: Are You a Good Witch or a Bad Witch?
episodes.summary: Terra shares an update with the group, while Musa keeps a secret. Bloom strikes a risky bargain with Sebastian in exchange for startling information.

episodes.title: Poor Unfortunate Souls
episodes.summary: Bloom faces serious consequences after losing control. As conflict looms over all of Solaria, a familiar face returns to Alfea one last time.

episodes.title: All the Wild Witches
episodes.summary: As the Blood Witches enact their plans, it's up to the students of Alfea to protect their school and their friends. Bloom must make a painful choice.
